name: Stream Tube Generation
definition: Stream tubes are created by inflating thin stream lines with volume to solve ambiguity in still images regarding line position and orientation. They are constructed with 5 sides (pentagonal cross-section) to save GPU memory while maintaining smooth shading.
summary: Stream Tube Generation inflates streamlines into volumetric pentagonal tubes to convey spatial structure through lighting, distinguishing itself by explicitly constructing 3D geometry rather than relying on image-space analysis.
